edits.name: clutter_spaced
edits.intent: Atlas layout edit only; fix rectangle overlap between separate source objects.
edits.prompt: Precise layout-only edit of the supplied transparent four-prop atlas. Preserve the same four original illustrated clutter compositions and their polished doodle material finish, forms, identities and colors. Fix ONLY atlas separation: rescale each entire composition to fit completely and independently within its own quadrant with AT LEAST 12% transparent margin inside every quadrant edge. Canvas 1536x1024, invisible grid 2 columns by 2 rows. Top-left sofa+box+all its fallen boards; top-right shelving+all its supporting rubble; bottom-left pushcart+crate+rope+all its supporting rubble; bottom-right cloth-covered submarine-left/hut-right. Four equal cells768x512. Every pixel of each composition must stay within its cell's inner safe rectangle, leaving a broad transparent horizontal and vertical gutter. The current lower-right cloth overlaps the lower-left rectangular extraction region: make it smaller and centered in its OWN bottom-right quadrant, without any sprite or shadow crossing x768 or y512. Background true alpha transparency with no filled checkerboard, gradient or floor. No text, grid, labels, new objects or visual design changes.

edits.name: app_icon
edits.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. A finished Android launcher icon for an original cozy sushi restaurant game, square opaque image 1024x1024. No text, letters, title, numbers, UI, logo words or border. Match the supplied doodle art catalog's thick rounded dark ink silhouette, dimensional storybook painted shading, warm highlights, simple chunky forms and calm material grain.
Centered subject: one highly recognizable bright salmon nigiri with three creamy diagonal striations over a plump rice cushion, resting on a small off-white round ceramic plate seen from a slightly overhead front view. The salmon and plate should visually match the newly created production props atlas. Broad expressive shape with appetizing orange-red salmon, glossy highlight and visible rounded white rice grains, no face or person, no chopsticks or extra food.
Background: solid deep harbor teal with subtle quiet paper texture and a soft circular warm illumination behind the plate. Keep the complete subject inside the center 65% of the square with at least18% outer safe area so Android circle and squircle crops never cut the plate. High clarity at tiny64px icon size. No scenery, no frame, no busy grain.
